min-block-size.$description: dimension used by the tab component for min block size (MarsUI Tab_nav md bar height 40px: 24px body_1 label + 8px block-end clearance + underline; retargeted from ki.space.7xl per the fidelity audit — material3 pins its own value).

padding-block-end.$description: dimension used by the tab component for padding block end (MarsUI Tab_nav_item: 8px inset keeping the 2px underline clear of the 13/24 label; formalizes the fallback ki-tab.css already consumes).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the tab component for padding inline (MarsUI items carry no inline padding: spacing comes from the bar gap and the underline spans the full item width).

gap.$description: dimension used by the tab component for gap.

radius.$description: dimension used by the tab component for radius.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the tab component for font size.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the tab component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the tab component for line height.

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected rest foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never purple; master 10048:1240).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected hover foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never purple; master 10048:1240).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected active foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never purple; master 10048:1240).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for selected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected rest foreground (Figma inactive is Text/low_em, which fails the 4.5:1 text gate at 13px; med_em is the gate-compliant rest value — declared deviation).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected hover foreground (with rest at med_em, hover darkens one em step, preserving the master rest-to-hover direction).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected active foreground (mirrors hover; MarsUI defines no pressed variant).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).

fg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).

bg.$description: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).

size.$description: dimension used by the tab component for indicator size.

color.$description: color used by the tab component for indicator color (MarsUI active underline is Outline/inverse_white: black in light, white in dark — the inverse neutral, not primary).

radius.$description: dimension used by the tab component for indicator radius (the master underline is a square-ended 2px bottom border).

color.$description: color used by the tab component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the tab component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
